speaker: alse_pinder
text: She says if you want the water hot you must take it now, sir, for the copper has the ink in it till noon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Set the ewer by the basin, Alse. A man can smell Monday through the floor of this house.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: And a wholesome smell it is. Galls, copperas, and gum, boiled to the hour, and never a blot that came of the receipt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: My horn is half full yet, Mistress, and black enough. I have no complaint against the receipt.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: When it wants filling it is twopence the horn, the same as it was at Michaelmas. Are you for the yard at nine, or do you keep the house till dinner?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No rehearsal this morning. I am at the desk till one, and at the Cross Keys for two.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is it the Roman play today, sir, or the one where Master Cowley had your gown when your throat was stopped?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Titus at two. The cold is gone. I can carry a speech across the yard.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Trumpets in an inn-yard are a din for the neighbours. Gillis was out to Norton Folgate before the bell. His shuttle makes less noise than your drums.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will not dispute a weaver's feet with a Roman's. He may keep the loom.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Will you take dinner before you go, sir? The loaf is on the board.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: A little, and a cup. I will not go down to Gracechurch Street full.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Threepence the meal whether you eat three bites or the trencher clean, and the penny loaf is still a finger short of the notch. I am not measuring it twice in three days.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave the notch in peace, Mistress. I will pay the threepence.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The grey cat was on your book when I came in, sir. I put him on the stool, and he went straight back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave him. I can hold a roll in my hand, and the book can bear a cat.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep the casement shut if the copper smokes. The kennel comes up with the wind.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The casement stays shut. I have lines enough indoors.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Do any of the Romans come home whole, sir?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Enough of them to clear the boards. That is as much as I will promise a kitchen.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Down with you, Alse, before the gum catches. Master Shakespeare has his afternoon, and my copper will not stir itself.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am coming, Mistress.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will take the crust at noon, and I am out by two.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The packet on your desk can stay there. I am not sending the girl to Carter Lane on a Monday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor am I. Thursday. The paper knows its own day.
